summary: Muay Thai stay and train camp on Thepprasit Road, Pattaya with passes from a single session to three months, covering Muay Thai, boxing, MMA, strength training, pool, sauna and ice bath.

facts.label: Single session
facts.quote: Single Session Pass - 700 THB/day (choose morning or afternoon)

facts.label: Training days
facts.quote: We train 6 days a week, and are closed on Sundays.

facts.label: Head trainers
facts.value: Head trainers include Namsaknoi and former Lumpinee champion Kaolan

facts.label: Accommodation
facts.quote: We provide ample parking, on-site accommodation, and a safe environment

facts.label: Levels
facts.quote: from complete beginners to professional fighters

facts.label: Location
